title: Utilization of WellPrept Journey for Postoperative Education and Patient Satisfaction Following HoLEP and Kidney Stone Surgery
official: Utilization of a Web-Based Application to Improve Procedure-Specific Postoperative Education and Patient Satisfaction in Holmium Laser Enucleation of the Prostate (HoLEP) Procedures and Kidney Stone Surgery
summary: The investigator and research team plan to evaluate the impact of an informational website, WellPrept and its "Journey" web-based tool on patient education during the postoperative period following their HoLEP and/or kidney stone removal procedure.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* In the HoLEP arm, men aged 18-100 who are undergoing HoLEP for the treatment of bothersome lower urinary tract symptoms, that are typically caused by enlarged prostates.
* In the Kidney stone arm, men and women aged 18-100 who are undergoing surgery for the treatment of stones in the kidney, urinary tract, or bladder.
* Ability to read, understand, and complete study questionnaires in English.
* Ability to provide informed consent.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Prostate volume greater than 200 g (HoLEP cohort only).
* Lack of decision-making capacity or inability to provide informed consent.
* Non-English-speaking patients.
